answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Taxi licence tenure with city authority renewals is the check: a cab licence renewed with the city every year. A farm faking 243 aliases needs 243 separate licence tenures, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the whisper signal is public, the fable check is automatic, and 243 aliases cost 243 times what one real agent costs, with the canyon trail open to all.
